name: Solend
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Solend, a lending protocol on Solana, tweeted that an oracle attack against USDH affecting Stable, Coin98, and Kamino’s isolated pools was detected, resulting in $1.26 million in bad debt. Additionally, Solend claims that all other pools, including the Main pool, are safe.
